title: Minimax Transported ATE Estimation under a Label-Query Budget with Many Categories
banked_reason: D0.5.G paper_score_ceiling 5 < 7.4 caps delivered tier at incremental; not salvageable within scope. Mathematically sound restricted fixed-budget theorem; reply-bit dependence and budget transitions require a new testing regime.
gap_reasons: The operational theorem treats one selected budget sequence and supplies an attaining allocation, but does not characterize reply-bit dependence or the budget transitions needed to substantiate the proposed precision-versus-score-range design guidance.

The explicit encoder returns zero whenever log(eN)<4096, and the enormous comparison constants plus absent finite-sample comparisons leave that prospective guidance unsupported at usable sample sizes.

[D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
proof_attempt_summary: Three D0 solve rounds established the restricted 1/log(eN) sandwich and strengthened it to one-sided overlap for C>=1 with a universal lower constant already at p=q; independent math and decision reviews reported no unrepaired mathematical findings. D0.5.G rated the delivered package incremental (score 5.0 versus field floor 7.4) because it covers one prescribed budget/decoder and lacks usable finite-sample precision guidance; independent terminal consultation confirmed no scoped tier repair. Preserve the informal endpoint certificate and exact-record testing proof for a fresh anchor on reply-bit dependence, budget transitions, or broader protocols; no Lean formalization was attempted.
tldr: A randomized source trial and an independent covariate-only target registry each provide \(N\) observations on \(N\) categories with unknown positive masses and one-sided overlap \(q_x/p_x\le C\), \(C\ge1\). At budget \(B_N=\lceil e^{\sqrt{\log(eN)}}\rceil\), the prescribed first-label-query and clipped scalar-reply collection has minimax transported-ATE squared risk of order \(1/\log(eN)\) for every \(N\ge2\). The lower constant is independent of \(C\), and the obstruction already holds without covariate shift, on \(p=q\). The inherited finite encoder attains the upper over every one-sided-overlap population. A matching actual-mark approximation frontier and an original-record testing construction cover every fixed finite score, repeated labels, clipping, rounding, and public retained-count overflow. This is an incremental interface benchmark for a prospective categorical trial-to-registry design.
gap: Known-target occupancy correction and generic stochastic duality leave a specific original-record question: how accurately can every permitted fixed-query score estimate a target-population causal effect after clipping and scalar rounding?
fill: A full-sequence marked approximation theorem and a same-law randomized testing converse determine the interface risk together with a total finite encoder. The theorem concerns the specified collection alone.
